name: FOSDEM 2026: GitHub Maintainer Social and Unconference
blurb: GitHub hosted a private Maintainer Social on Sunday night (February 1) and a Maintainer Unconference on Monday morning (February 2) for open source maintainers attending FOSDEM.

name: GitHub Copilot Dev Days 2026 (March 15–May 15)
blurb: A global, in-person user group initiative running March 15 to May 15, 2026, with events led by local tech communities and sessions of approximately 3 hours.

name: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026
blurb: GitHub was listed as a Gold sponsor, scheduled a booth 931 demo of GitHub Copilot Agentic Workflows on March 25, and had a speaker in a Flux session on ephemeral Kubernetes environments from pull requests.

name: GitHub at RSAC 2026
blurb: GitHub listed Hub Booth 2327, The Dock by GitHub lounge and a reception, and Madison Oliver of GitHub Security Research spoke on March 24 in the panel “The Patchless Age: Year Zero After The Great CVE Collapse”.
note: GitHub page states only the March 24 session date, not the conference dates.

name: AI Engineer Europe 2026
blurb: GitHub Next’s Maggie Appleton presented “One Developer, Two Dozen Agents, Zero Alignment” on April 9; the schedule also lists GitHub’s Sam Morrow on April 10 on scaling GitHub’s Remote MCP Server.

name: VulnCon 2026
blurb: GitHub Security Lab lists a panel with Shelby Cunningham, Art Manion, Caitlin Condon and David Welch on the role CVE plays in identifying and disseminating information about malware embedded into otherwise legitimate software.
note: GitHub Security Lab page lists April 16, 2026.

name: Devoxx France 2026
blurb: GitHub Security Lab lists the workshop “Shall we play a Game? LLM Security in Practice” with Joseph Katsioloudes and Xavier René-Corail on Wednesday, April 22.

name: PyCon US 2026
blurb: GitHub Security Lab lists a session by Madison Ficorilli and Shelby Cunningham on the role CVE plays in identifying and disseminating information about malware in legitimate packages, and what it means for defenders of Python packages.
note: GitHub Security Lab page lists May 16, 2026, Long Beach.

name: GitHub Social Club at Microsoft Build 2026
blurb: GitHub’s event page lists a GitHub Commons, a DevTools Area with GitHub Copilot CLI demos, a catalog of sessions highlighting GitHub, and a GitHub Social Club on June 1 for registered Build attendees.
note: GitHub Build page states the Social Club on Monday, June 1; it does not state the Build conference dates.

name: OpenClaw: After Hours at GitHub
blurb: An evening at GitHub HQ during Microsoft Build 2026 for the OpenClaw community, with a fireside conversation featuring Peter Steinberger, a maintainer panel, lightning talks and a happy hour.

name: Beyond Build: AI Developer Day
blurb: A post-Build add-on day at GitHub HQ (8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. PDT) with live demos and interactive sessions from GitHub DevRel, Expert Learning Services and Microsoft Global Skilling.

name: GitHub Next at AI Engineer World’s Fair 2026
blurb: GitHub Next presented the talk “Realtime multiplayer, automation, and you!” at the conference on July 2, 2026.
note: GitHub Next talk page states Jul 2, 2026.

name: Dev Days 2026 (September 1–October 31)
blurb: A global, in-person user group initiative running September 1 to October 31, 2026, to explore the power of GitHub Copilot, with sessions of approximately 2-3 hours.

name: GitHub Connect Tour: APAC
location: Melbourne, Auckland, Wellington, Singapore, Bangkok, Shanghai
blurb: Stops listed on GitHub’s page: Melbourne (September 3), Auckland (September 8), Wellington (September 10), Singapore (November 19), Bangkok (November 26) and Shanghai (December 3), 2026.

name: GitHub Game Off 2026
blurb: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam returns for its 14th year with the theme SHIFT, running until December 1, 2026, at 13:37 PST.

name: GitHub Social Club at Microsoft Ignite
blurb: A GitHub Social Club for Microsoft Ignite attendees, described on GitHub’s events page as hands-on building, bites, sips, and networking.

name: Microsoft Ignite 2026
blurb: Listed on GitHub’s events page as San Francisco, CA, November 17–20, 2026; the listing does not name a GitHub booth or session.

name: Webinar: Measuring What Matters: Proving the ROI of AI-Powered Engineering
blurb: GitHub webinar on measuring the impact of GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows with real outcomes, not anecdotes.

name: Webinar: Building for the Frontier Firm: What’s Next for GitHub + AI
blurb: GitHub webinar on the future of agentic development and how GitHub powers trusted, autonomous workflows.
